name: PingUp AI+ | AI Chatbot & AI Agent
author: etinet

sections.description:
Turn your website content into answers, leads and sales opportunities

PingUp AI+ is an AI chatbot for WordPress and websites designed for customer support, lead generation, product discovery and conversational ecommerce.

It can be deployed in minutes, requires no coding and uses your company’s actual content to answer visitor questions.

Web pages, FAQs, PDF documents, product pages and technical content become a conversational knowledge base that customers can explore using natural language.

Unlike generic AI chatbots, PingUp AI+ uses a RAG-powered chatbot engine combining semantic and deterministic search to retrieve relevant information from customer-approved sources.

It can help visitors:

  • find information quickly;
  • discover products and services;
  • compare available options;
  • receive assistance around the clock;
  • reach the most relevant page;
  • continue the conversation through WhatsApp.

PingUp AI+ combines a straightforward no-code setup with advanced AI retrieval, ecommerce features, analytics and WhatsApp integrations.

🎯 Support. Recommend. Convert.

PingUp AI+ is more than a simple FAQ chatbot.

It can assist users throughout the customer journey:

Awareness

Introduce the company, services and key information.

Consideration

Explain features, requirements and available alternatives.

Decision

Recommend relevant products, services and content.

Conversion

Direct the user to a product page, contact request or WhatsApp conversation.

Support

Answer customer questions using approved company information.

⚙️ How PingUp AI+ works

1. 📥 Install the plugin

Install and activate PingUp AI+ from your WordPress dashboard.

A secure connection links the website to your PingUp account without requiring a complex manual API configuration.

The WordPress plugin with secure SSO connection is currently in development and will be available soon.

A lightweight JavaScript snippet is available for other platforms and custom websites.

2. 🔗 Connect your knowledge sources

Choose the content your AI chatbot should know:

  • web pages and posts;
  • individual URLs;
  • XML sitemaps;
  • PDF documents;
  • custom text;
  • FAQs;
  • technical documentation;
  • product pages;
  • ecommerce catalogs.

There is no need to manually create hundreds of question-and-answer combinations.

PingUp AI+ crawls, processes and indexes the selected content.

3. 🎨 Customize the chatbot

Configure the widget from the dashboard:

  • colors;
  • logo;
  • position;
  • light or dark mode;
  • welcome messages;
  • quick replies;
  • automatic opening;
  • typewriter effect;
  • calls to action;
  • WhatsApp connection.

No theme or code changes are required.

4. 🌐 Publish the widget

Review your sources and chatbot preview, then publish it on the website.

PingUp AI+ can start answering questions and directing users to the most relevant information, product or communication channel.

5. 📊 Analyze customer conversations

Conversations generate analytics, intent classifications and content-gap insights.

Discover:

  • what visitors are looking for;
  • which products attract interest;
  • which questions are asked most often;
  • where website information is incomplete;
  • which conversations show commercial potential.

⭐ Why choose PingUp AI+?

⚡ Fast deployment

Connect your website, add your sources, customize the widget and publish.

The initial setup is designed to take only a few minutes.

🧩 No-code configuration

No development, prompt engineering or vector-database experience is required.

The main settings are managed through a visual dashboard.

📚 Answers based on your content

PingUp AI+ uses knowledge sources selected by your organization instead of relying exclusively on the general knowledge of an AI model.

This helps keep answers aligned with your actual products, services and documentation.

🔍 Accurate search across complex catalogs

Hybrid retrieval combines semantic understanding with exact matching.

The chatbot can understand natural-language requests while retaining precision for:

  • product codes;
  • models;
  • technical names;
  • locations;
  • specifications;
  • price ranges.

🎯 Built for lead generation and conversions

PingUp AI+ recognizes conversational intent and can direct visitors to:

  • products;
  • landing pages;
  • forms;
  • quotation requests;
  • sales contacts;
  • WhatsApp Business.

🔄 Automatically updated knowledge

Knowledge sources identified as stale can be automatically recrawled overnight.

This keeps the chatbot aligned with the latest published website content.

📈 Insights for SEO, marketing and customer care

Visitor questions reveal needs, objections and missing information.

PingUp AI+ turns conversations into insights that can be used to:

  • improve website pages and FAQs;
  • optimize product content;
  • plan new resources;
  • refine campaigns and sales messaging;
  • reduce repetitive support enquiries.

🧠 Core Features

RAG AI Chatbot Engine

PingUp AI+ uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation to search customer-approved knowledge sources before creating an answer.

This allows the chatbot to provide responses grounded in the company’s content.

Hybrid Search

PingUp AI+ combines:

Semantic search

Understands the meaning and intent behind a question.

Deterministic search

Finds exact words, codes, product names and specific matches.

This combination improves both conversational queries and technical searches.

Context-aware follow-up questions

PingUp AI+ keeps track of the active conversation.

For example, a visitor may ask:

“Which model is the most affordable?”

and then:

“Is it available in black?”

The chatbot understands that the second question refers to the product discussed previously.

PingUp AI+ internally rewrites follow-up queries with the necessary context before searching the knowledge base again.

Intent Detection

PingUp AI+ identifies the primary purpose of each conversation, including:

  • information requests;
  • support needs;
  • solution comparison;
  • commercial interest;
  • purchase intent;
  • contact requests;
  • post-purchase support.

Detected intents are aggregated in the analytics dashboard.

Multi-format knowledge base

Supported sources include:

  • URLs;
  • sitemaps;
  • web pages;
  • blog posts;
  • PDF files;
  • custom text;
  • FAQs;
  • technical documentation;
  • product pages.

Automatic website crawling

PingUp AI+ can crawl individual pages or complete website sections through an XML sitemap.

Sources requiring an update can be automatically recrawled overnight.

Automatic metadata extraction

When a page is imported, PingUp AI+ can also analyze:

  • SEO titles;
  • meta descriptions;
  • Open Graph data;
  • images;
  • structured data;
  • Schema.org markup;
  • product metadata.

This information improves content interpretation and in-chat presentation.

Customizable chatbot widget

Match the chatbot to your website through:

  • custom branding;
  • logo;
  • colors;
  • dark mode;
  • widget position;
  • welcome messages;
  • placeholders;
  • quick replies;
  • automatic opening;
  • typewriter animation;
  • desktop and mobile settings.

Multilingual interface

The widget and dashboard are available in English and Italian.

Knowledge sources can be organized by language for multilingual websites.

Conversation Analytics

The dashboard provides:

  • complete conversations;
  • message volumes;
  • time-series data;
  • usage by chatbot;
  • usage by organization;
  • popular questions;
  • detected intents;
  • unanswered questions.

AI Intelligence

AI Intelligence analyzes conversations and turns them into actionable insights.

It includes:

  • intent classification;
  • conversation trends;
  • monthly email reports;
  • content-gap detection;
  • alerts for questions without an adequate answer.

Teams and multiple organizations

PingUp AI+ is designed for companies, groups and agencies.

It supports:

  • multiple users;
  • team invitations;
  • multiple organizations;
  • multiple chatbots;
  • multiple widgets;
  • multiple domains;
  • plan-based access and limits.

Custom webhooks and events

PingUp AI+ can connect chatbot interactions to external workflows through custom webhooks and events.

The widget can also trigger configured Meta/Facebook Pixel events, subject to the website’s consent and privacy settings.

🛒 AI Chatbot for Ecommerce and WooCommerce

PingUp AI+ can turn an online catalog into a conversational commerce experience.

Visitors do not need to understand categories, filters or technical terminology.

They can simply explain what they need:

“I need an outdoor solution under €200.”

“Which product is best for a beginner?”

“Show me an available model with these features.”

PingUp AI+ analyzes the request, searches the indexed catalog and recommends relevant alternatives.

Product Advisor

The Product Advisor uses information from indexed product pages to recommend items based on:

  • customer needs;
  • requested features;
  • category;
  • price;
  • availability;
  • stated preferences;
  • conversation context.

Product cards in chat

Search results can be displayed as product cards containing:

  • image;
  • product name;
  • price;
  • availability;
  • rating;
  • product-page link.

Product Preview

Product Preview shows how PingUp AI+ interprets a product page before it is presented to visitors.

It can be used to validate:

  • image;
  • price;
  • availability;
  • rating;
  • structured product information.

Valid Schema.org structured data is required to generate complete product cards.

Checkout stays on your website

PingUp AI+ does not replace the ecommerce checkout and does not directly process payments.

The chatbot guides customers to the relevant product page or buying journey, which continues on the website.

💬 WhatsApp Business and PingUp WhatsApp API

From website question to sales conversation

When a visitor requires human assistance or shows strong commercial interest, PingUp AI+ can display a WhatsApp call to action.

The CTA can include:

  • a WhatsApp Business number;
  • a pre-filled message;
  • custom button text;
  • display conditions;
  • contextual information.

This creates a direct path from website assistance to a conversation with the company.

PingUp WhatsApp API

For more advanced use cases, PingUp WhatsApp API can extend AI-powered conversations directly to WhatsApp.

Depending on the selected service and subscription plan, it can support workflows for:

  • lead generation;
  • enquiry qualification;
  • customer support;
  • information delivery;
  • human escalation;
  • conversational automation;
  • continuity between website and WhatsApp.

PingUp WhatsApp API features are available on eligible plans.

🧩 Add-ons and premium features

Product Advisor and Product Cards

Unlock catalog recommendations, product cards and product-data preview.

WhatsApp Integration

Enable configurable handoff to a WhatsApp Business number.

PingUp WhatsApp API

Extend AI conversations and automations across WhatsApp.

Advanced AI Intelligence

Unlock additional intent analysis, time-series analytics, reports and content-gap insights.

Watermark Removal

Remove PingUp AI+ branding from the chatbot widget.

White Label

Customize the chatbot experience for a company or agency brand.

Additional Bots, Domains and Organizations

Increase account limits for multiple websites, brands, customers or business units.

Feature availability depends on the selected subscription plan.

👥 Who can benefit from PingUp AI+?

🛍️ AI Chatbot for ecommerce and retail

PingUp AI+ helps customers find, understand and compare products.

It can provide:

  • conversational catalog search;
  • personalized product suggestions;
  • product comparisons;
  • price and availability information;
  • links to relevant product pages;
  • WhatsApp handoff.

It is suitable for WooCommerce stores, fashion, furniture, electronics, beauty, food, spare parts and B2B catalogs.

🏥 AI Chatbot for healthcare

Clinics, healthcare centers and medical organizations can make the following information easier to access:

  • services;
  • locations;
  • opening hours;
  • exam preparation;
  • procedures;
  • booking instructions;
  • documentation;
  • administrative FAQs.

PingUp AI+ does not provide diagnoses and should not replace healthcare professionals.

🏦 AI Chatbot for financial services and banking

Banks, insurance providers and financial organizations can use PingUp AI+ to simplify access to:

  • products and services;
  • requirements;
  • procedures;
  • documentation;
  • published terms;
  • customer support channels;
  • appointment information.

The chatbot should not replace regulated financial advice or professional assessments.

🏠 AI Chatbot for real estate

Real estate agencies can help visitors find properties based on:

  • location;
  • property type;
  • budget;
  • size;
  • number of rooms;
  • features;
  • availability.

Interested leads can be directed to a property page or transferred to WhatsApp.

✈️ AI Chatbot for travel and hospitality

Hotels, resorts, travel agencies and tour operators can answer questions about:

  • rooms;
  • destinations;
  • itineraries;
  • services;
  • policies;
  • check-in and check-out;
  • dining;
  • activities;
  • booking procedures.

🎓 AI Chatbot for education

Schools, universities and training organizations can provide information about:

  • courses;
  • programs;
  • requirements;
  • fees;
  • calendars;
  • enrollment;
  • learning materials;
  • student FAQs.

👤 AI Chatbot for Human Resources

PingUp AI+ can support HR and recruitment teams with:

  • job information;
  • candidate FAQs;
  • company culture and benefits;
  • application procedures;
  • onboarding;
  • internal policies.

It does not automatically make recruitment decisions.

🎧 AI Chatbot for customer service

Organizations with high volumes of repetitive enquiries can use PingUp AI+ as a first level of customer assistance.

It can answer common questions and direct visitors to the correct documentation, procedure, page or contact.

Questions that cannot be answered adequately are identified as content gaps.

📣 AI Chatbot for marketing and advertising

Marketing teams and agencies can use PingUp AI+ to:

  • explain services;
  • qualify interest;
  • recommend landing pages;
  • identify intent;
  • trigger events;
  • collect customer insights;
  • move prospects to WhatsApp.

🎟️ AI Chatbot for event management

Conferences, exhibitions, webinars and venues can provide updated information about:

  • schedules;
  • speakers;
  • tickets;
  • locations;
  • opening times;
  • sponsors;
  • accessibility;
  • attendance procedures.

🍽️ AI Chatbot for restaurants and food services

Restaurants, chains and food-service businesses can answer questions about:

  • menus;
  • ingredients;
  • published allergens;
  • locations;
  • opening hours;
  • events;
  • reservations;
  • delivery.

The chatbot can direct visitors to the booking system or open a WhatsApp conversation.

🏭 AI Chatbot for B2B businesses

Manufacturers, distributors, software companies and consultancies can transform technical documentation and catalogs into a searchable AI assistant.

PingUp AI+ helps users understand complex products, compatibility, differences and contact procedures.

🛠️ Technical Specifications

Product type

AI chatbot SaaS including:

  • WordPress plugin;
  • website widget;
  • JavaScript snippet;
  • cloud dashboard;
  • optional integrations.

AI engine

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation;
  • semantic search;
  • deterministic search;
  • hybrid retrieval;
  • context-aware query rewriting;
  • conversation memory;
  • intent detection.

Supported knowledge sources

  • URLs;
  • XML sitemaps;
  • web pages;
  • posts;
  • PDFs;
  • custom text;
  • FAQs;
  • technical documentation;
  • product pages.

Ecommerce features

  • product catalog indexing;
  • Product Advisor;
  • product cards;
  • Product Preview;
  • pricing data;
  • availability;
  • ratings;
  • product-page links.

Supported channels

  • WordPress;
  • websites through JavaScript;
  • WhatsApp Business CTA;
  • PingUp WhatsApp API;
  • webhooks;
  • custom events;
  • Meta Pixel.

Widget

  • no-code configuration;
  • responsive layout;
  • light and dark themes;
  • custom logo and colors;
  • position settings;
  • quick replies;
  • auto-open;
  • typewriter effect;
  • custom messages.

Dashboard

  • conversation history;
  • analytics;
  • time-series data;
  • intent analysis;
  • monthly reports;
  • content gaps;
  • users and teams;
  • organizations;
  • plan-based limits.

Interface languages

  • English;
  • Italian.

Billing

  • free plan;
  • monthly subscriptions;
  • annual subscriptions;
  • Stripe payments;
  • automatic monthly usage reset;
  • feature gating;
  • plan-based limits.

🚀 Take your website to the next level with PingUp AI+

Install the AI chatbot, connect your content and start turning visitor questions into answers, leads and sales opportunities.

Activate PingUp AI+ and move your most valuable conversations from your website to WhatsApp.

External services

This plugin relies on PingUp, a third-party hosted AI chat assistant service, to work.

Once you have connected your account, selected a bot and enabled the widget:

  • Your site’s frontend loads the PingUp widget script from PingUp’s servers and displays the chat widget to your visitors.
  • Messages that visitors type into the chat widget are sent to and processed by the PingUp service in order to generate replies.
  • Your WordPress server communicates with the PingUp API (to list your bots, to manage the connection and to verify twice a day that the connection has not been revoked) using a revocable, site-specific access token stored in your WordPress options.

No data is sent to PingUp before you explicitly connect the plugin to your PingUp account, and nothing is loaded on your site’s frontend until you also select a bot.

Service provider: PingUp — Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate PingUp AI+ on WordPress.
  2. Connect or create your PingUp account.
  3. Associate the website with a chatbot.
  4. Add URLs, sitemaps, PDFs or other sources.
  5. Customize the chatbot widget.
  6. Configure the optional WhatsApp CTA.
  7. Test the chatbot using the preview.
  8. Publish the widget.

For non-WordPress websites, use the JavaScript snippet available in the dashboard.
sections.faq:
What is PingUp AI+?

PingUp AI+ is an AI chatbot for WordPress and websites that uses indexed company content to answer questions, recommend products, support visitors and generate commercial opportunities.

How is it different from a generic AI chatbot?

PingUp AI+ uses a customer-controlled knowledge base and a RAG-powered retrieval engine.

Before generating an answer, it searches approved web pages, PDF documents, FAQs, technical content and product pages.

Do I need coding skills?

No. Installation, source management, customization and publication are handled through no-code interfaces.

How long does setup take?

The website connection and widget configuration can be completed in a few minutes.

Knowledge-indexing time depends on the number and size of the selected sources.

Can I train the chatbot on my website content?

Yes. You can add individual URLs, sitemaps, pages, posts, PDFs, FAQs, custom text and product pages.

Is website content updated automatically?

Sources identified as stale can be automatically recrawled overnight.

Does PingUp AI+ work with WooCommerce?

It can index and use accessible WooCommerce product pages.

Product Advisor, Product Cards and Product Preview depend on the active plan and the quality of the available product data.

Can the chatbot recommend products?

Yes. Product Advisor searches the indexed catalog and recommends products based on the visitor’s requirements.

Can customers purchase inside the chat?

No. The checkout remains on the ecommerce website.

PingUp AI+ directs customers to the appropriate product page or purchase journey.

Why is Schema.org structured data important?

Structured data helps PingUp AI+ correctly identify product images, prices, availability, ratings and other product information.

Does the chatbot understand follow-up questions?

Yes. PingUp AI+ uses conversation context to understand references to previously discussed products, services and information.

Can I connect PingUp AI+ to WhatsApp Business?

Yes. You can configure a call to action that transfers the conversation to your company’s WhatsApp Business number.

What is the difference between the WhatsApp CTA and PingUp WhatsApp API?

The CTA opens a conversation with the configured business number.

PingUp WhatsApp API extends AI and automation features directly to WhatsApp, depending on the activated service and plan.

Can I customize the chatbot?

Yes. You can customize colors, logo, position, theme, messages, quick replies, auto-open behavior and the typewriter effect.

Can I review user conversations?

Yes. Conversations and analytics are available through the dashboard according to the selected plan and retention settings.

What are content gaps?

Content gaps are questions that cannot be adequately answered using the available knowledge sources.

PingUp AI+ identifies them so you can improve website content, FAQs and documentation.

Can PingUp AI+ generate leads?

The chatbot can detect commercial intent, direct users to relevant calls to action and move interested prospects to WhatsApp.

Can I manage multiple websites?

Yes. Available domains, chatbots, widgets and organizations depend on the selected plan.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. PingUp AI+ uses a freemium model with a free plan and monthly or annual subscriptions offering different limits and features.

How are monthly messages calculated?

Each plan includes a monthly message allowance that automatically resets at the beginning of each billing period.

Can I remove the PingUp AI+ watermark?

Watermark removal is available on eligible plans.

Is white label available?

Yes. White-label functionality is available on eligible subscription plans.

Can PingUp AI+ be used in healthcare or financial services?

It can provide information from approved sources, but it should not replace doctors, financial advisers or other qualified professionals.

Are AI answers always accurate?

No AI system can guarantee absolute accuracy.

Controlled knowledge sources, RAG retrieval and content-gap analysis improve relevance and control, but conversations should still be monitored, particularly in regulated industries.
sections.changelog:
0.1.1

  • Admin brand styles moved from an inline style block to an enqueued stylesheet (assets/admin.css), loaded only on the plugin page.
  • Removed bundled translation files and the load_plugin_textdomain() call: translations are delivered by translate.wordpress.org.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: secure connect flow (authorization code + PKCE), bot selection with cached list, enable/disable toggle, frontend widget injection, disconnect.

External services

This plugin relies on PingUp, a third-party hosted AI chat assistant service, to work.

Once you have connected your account, selected a bot and enabled the widget:

  • Your site’s frontend loads the PingUp widget script from PingUp’s servers and displays the chat widget to your visitors.
  • Messages that visitors type into the chat widget are sent to and processed by the PingUp service in order to generate replies.
  • Your WordPress server communicates with the PingUp API (to list your bots, to manage the connection and to verify twice a day that the connection has not been revoked) using a revocable, site-specific access token stored in your WordPress options.

No data is sent to PingUp before you explicitly connect the plugin to your PingUp account, and nothing is loaded on your site’s frontend until you also select a bot.
